━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Semantic Understanding
NO Intent Classification
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Analyzes:
• User request semantics
• Conversation context
• Available agents (18)
• Off-topic detection
• Action requirements
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Outputs:
• WorkflowPlan
• AgentTask[] with deps
• Parallel execution groups
